versions.text: Criterion: Verify that stall characteristics are safe. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within MIL-STD-1797, 5.2.5.3 Stall characteristics. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, requirements, design, test, and configuration documentation. Additional References: 14 CFR 23.201 Wings level stall; 23.203 Turning flight and accelerated turning stalls 14 CFR 25.201 Stall demonstrations; 25.203 Stall characteristics

Standard: The air vehicle's stall characteristics meet the standards as specified in MIL-STD- 1797, Stall Characteristics paragraph. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the stall characteristics as specified in MIL-STD- 1797, Stall Characteristics paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the stall characteristics as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Stall Characteristics paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the stall characteristics as specified in MIL-STD- 1797, Stall Characteristics paragraph for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
